item.title: AI Field Notes: Discussing AI Sentiment, Future, and Issues | Tech Punk #1
item.description: In Episode 1 of Tech Punk, I share my views and questions about AI, covering personal and widespread sentiment, making predictions on the future of AI and whether the bubble will burst, and dissecting the issues of AI.
